title: SPeCtrum: A Grounded Framework for Multidimensional Identity Representation in LLM-Based Agent

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the comprehensiveness and authenticity of LLM-generated personas across different combinations of identity components (demographics, personality, and life context) using character identification tasks, the Twenty Statements Test (TST), and human self-perception ratings to measure the reduction of generic, stereotyped demographic portrayals.
